about: Control surface vectors (docs/09-phase-8.md, workstream D; docs/control/README.md): Anode.Control computes these, and the server's surface sessions must reproduce them. Each session makes fresh units of `units` (ControlSurfaces.Create), left to right in one SurfaceGroup, and runs its steps in order. `op` is one of: `encode` (SurfaceGroup.Encode(views[view]); `out` is each unit's messages, in order, as hex), `meters` (SurfaceGroup.EncodeMeters(views[view]); `out` likewise), `poll` (SurfaceGroup.Poll(timeNs); `out` likewise), `decode` (SurfaceGroup.Decode(unit, bytes of `in`, timeNs); `actions` are the SurfaceActions in order: kind as the camelCase SurfaceActionKind name, strip, trackId, address, value (compare within 1e-9), automation as the AutomationMode JSON name), `invalidate` (every unit's Invalidate()). After each step `bank` is the group's BankBase and `connected` each unit's Connected. `views` are ProjectViews in the contracts' JSON (camelCase).
